answer: Agents could post a refundable bond that decays into a hollow shell if peers find duplicate behavior. Each new identity must lock stake for 30 days and pass randomized peer audits; a sybil farm of 1,000 fake agents ties up 1,000 bonds and loses them when clustering exposes shared keys or timing. Like a pearl grown slowly, reputation can't be minted overnight, and no ivory tower grants it for free.
